question: Which deployment was rolled back immediately before invoice generation recovered at 09:14 UTC?
initial_context: Approved change ticket CHG-910 records rollback of billing-api-2026.07.22.7 at 09:12 UTC and restoration of invoice generation at 09:14 UTC.

record-a.content: The archived CHG-910 bundle confirms that billing-api-2026.07.22.7 was rolled back before invoice generation recovered. It adds no material fact beyond the approved ticket in the initial context.

record-b.content: 09:13 UTC invoice generation remained degraded. 09:14 UTC the synthetic invoice check passed. 09:16 UTC the recovery was declared stable. This record contains no deployment identifier.

record-c.content: invoice-worker-2026.07.22.2 completed a routine rollout at 08:45 UTC. Worker queue depth and error rate remained normal throughout the later billing incident.

record-d.content: Responders agreed to roll back the billing API change named in CHG-910. The discussion records recovery but abbreviates the deployment as 'the CHG-910 billing rollout.'
